_comment: Which release updates which catalog entry. Read by bump.py, which
the workflow catalog-bump runs each hour: when the newest release of a row
is newer than its entry, it opens a pull request that lists it.
repo: where the release and its zip are. tagPrefix: the tag is this
followed by the version. asset: the zip's name, {version} filled in.
manual: entries that are only ever changed by hand, and why.
//catalog:bump_test fails when an entry is in neither list.

manual.dev.vitruvian.reference: Attached to a release of the SDK whose tag is the SDK's version, not the tool's.
